def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    return np.where(bins >= item, -(bins - item), -np.inf)

algorithm: {For each bin, calculate the remaining capacity after placing the item into it, assign a priority score equal to the negative of that remaining capacity if the bin can fit the item, otherwise assign negative infinity so that higher scores correspond to bins that minimize leftover space after packing the item.}

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    mask = bins >= item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    scores[mask] = -(bins[mask] - item)
    return scores
